title: I-Echo Edlula Emaweni
intro: Cabanga ngesigodi lapho izindlu ziqoshwe khona emaweni, futhi umoya uphethe inkumbulo yesixwayiso esingalalelwanga. Abantu bake bachuma lapha, bebusisiwe kodwa bephikisana, kwaze kwaba yilapho kuvela isibonakaliso edwaleni ababelithemba.
clues: Sasingabantu ababeqopha amakhaya aphephile ezintabeni, bezizwa bephephile ezindlini zethu ezinamadwala.
Sasihlala ezweni elinamathafa namatshe, elibusiswe ngezingadi nemithombo yamanzi.
Isithunywa esivela phakathi kwethu safika, sisibiza ukuba silahle onkulunkulu bethu bamanga sikhulekele uMdali weqiniso oyedwa.
Ngokuzidla sabeka umbandela wokukholelwa: uphawu oluyingqayizivele olwaluzovela emadwaleni esiwaqophile.
Lapho ikamela lensikazi elithenjisiwe livela edwaleni, uphawu olucacile, abaphezulu bethu baqhubeka benqaba futhi balinquma imisipha naphezu kwesixwayiso senhlekelele ezayo.
Ngemva kwezinsuku ezintathu senzile, kwaduma umsindo omkhulu esigodini, futhi saphela saba yimfucumfucu ewile, imizi yethu yaba amathuna ethu.
arabic: وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَآ إِلَىٰ ثَمُودَ أَخَاهُمْ صَـٰلِحًا أَنِ ٱعْبُدُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ فَإِذَا هُمْ فَرِيقَانِ يَخْتَصِمُونَ
verse: And We had certainly sent to Thamūd their brother Ṣāliḥ, [saying], "Worship Allāh," and at once they were two parties conflicting. (27:45)
